recipes.name: adguard-home
requirements: Supply a reviewed DNS deployment with persistent /opt/adguardhome/work and /opt/adguardhome/conf, first-administrator setup, and authenticated admin readiness.
Decide which private clients may use TCP/UDP 53 and how to avoid conflicts with the host resolver; the recipe must not silently bind public DNS or grant host networking.

recipes.name: airflow
requirements: Use a supported Apache Airflow version with initialized persistent PostgreSQL metadata, scheduler, triggerer, web/API server and the chosen executor/worker services.
Provision Fernet/API signing keys and a real administrator, run matching database migrations, and check scheduler/executor health before accepting jobs.

recipes.name: appsmith
requirements: All-in-one evaluation deployment; complete administrator onboarding and configure datasource secrets through the SSH tunnel.

recipes.name: argocd
requirements: Provide a supported existing Kubernetes cluster and least-privilege kubeconfig, then install version-pinned Argo CD namespace/CRDs/controller/server/repository services.
Persist the cluster configuration and supply administrator bootstrap handling; expose only a loopback port-forward until authenticated TLS and Git credentials are configured.

recipes.name: audiobookshelf
requirements: Complete administrator onboarding through the SSH tunnel; populate the named audiobook/podcast volumes with authorized media.

recipes.name: authentik
requirements: Deploy matching Authentik server and worker images with persistent PostgreSQL and the selected version's required cache/task services; generate a stable secret key and bootstrap account.
Choose an externally valid URL, trusted proxy/TLS configuration and email settings before identity-provider use; complete migrations and authenticated readiness.

recipes.name: awx
requirements: Deploy a version-matched AWX Operator into a supported Kubernetes cluster with a dedicated namespace, persistent PostgreSQL and AWX custom resource.
Provide least-privilege kubeconfig, administrator secret, execution environment and trusted automation credentials; a standalone AWX container is not the supported stack.

recipes.name: baikal
requirements: Complete the CalDAV/CardDAV installer and administrator setup through the SSH tunnel; SQLite/configuration persist in owned volumes.

recipes.name: bazarr
requirements: Loopback-only evaluation. Complete application setup and authentication before exposing it through a TLS proxy.
Persistent named volumes start empty; configure the intended libraries, backups, or upstream services explicitly.

recipes.name: bookstack
requirements: Complete the private MariaDB plus BookStack stack with persistent /config, generated APP_KEY and stable APP_URL.
Change the upstream bootstrap administrator credentials, configure email/TLS and perform database and authenticated application readiness checks.

recipes.name: budibase
requirements: All-in-one evaluation deployment with internal services and durable /data; complete administrator onboarding before use.

recipes.name: calcom
requirements: Provide a supported Cal.com application image with persistent PostgreSQL, Prisma migrations, authentication/encryption keys and valid application/authentication URLs.
Configure the needed OAuth/calendar providers and email credentials explicitly; validate the exact image architecture and scheduled/background services.

recipes.name: casdoor
requirements: Persist a supported SQL database and Casdoor configuration/initialization data; configure driver, connection parameters, origin and bootstrap accounts for the chosen release.
Configure valid authentication callback domains, trusted OAuth/SAML providers and TLS; the stock image alone does not define an identity deployment.

recipes.name: cassandra
requirements: Single-node CQL evaluation with loopback-only unauthenticated access. Configure authentication, replication and backups before attaching untrusted clients.

recipes.name: chatwoot
requirements: Run compatible Rails web and Sidekiq worker images with persistent PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis and uploads; perform the matching database preparation.
Generate SECRET_KEY_BASE and configure a valid frontend URL, SMTP and approved messaging-provider credentials; verify worker and authenticated web readiness.

recipes.name: clickhouse
requirements: Authenticated single-node HTTP SQL endpoint; native port 9000 is not mapped. Credentials remain in a mode-0600 file on the instance.

recipes.name: cloud-init-report
recipes.description: Inspect current cloud-init status and recent bootstrap errors without rerunning initialization.

recipes.name: cockroachdb
requirements: Explicitly insecure single-node UI evaluation: SQL is container-local and not mapped. This is not a secure production database cluster.

recipes.name: code-server
requirements: Login with the generated password from the private credentials.env. No host Docker socket is mounted; workspaces remain in the owned config volume.

recipes.name: coder
requirements: Control-plane evaluation with private PostgreSQL and explicit listener/access URL; complete first-administrator onboarding.
Workspace templates/provisioners and their credentials are not bundled; no privileged Docker socket is mounted.

recipes.name: consul
requirements: Single-node evaluation, not dev mode, with durable Raft data. No gossip/DNS ports or host socket are mapped; configure ACLs/TLS before attaching clients.

recipes.name: couchdb
requirements: Authenticated single-node CouchDB; bootstrap credentials are stored on the instance with mode 0600.

recipes.name: dashy
requirements: Configure dashboard links and access control in the persistent user-data volume; this empty local dashboard is not an authenticated public portal.

recipes.name: dendrite
requirements: Select a maintained supported Dendrite image/release and configure persistent database, media and the required event broker for that version.
Supply immutable Matrix server name and signing keys, valid TLS/federation/proxy settings and explicit account registration/admin policy; do not substitute an empty monolith container.

recipes.name: directus
requirements: Standalone SQLite and persisted uploads/extensions; login using the privately generated administrator password.
Configure a public URL, database backups, trusted extensions, email and TLS before external use.

recipes.name: discourse
requirements: Build a supported official Discourse application image/container bundle with persistent PostgreSQL, Redis, uploads and background jobs; retire the unavailable Bitnami latest reference.
Provide a real hostname, SMTP credentials, bootstrap administrator and TLS; run matching setup/migrations and verify email/background services.

recipes.name: disk-report
recipes.description: Read-only block-device and filesystem capacity diagnostics.

recipes.name: docker-report
recipes.description: Read-only Docker engine, container, and storage diagnostics; never prunes resources.

recipes.name: docspell
requirements: Deploy matching Docspell restserver and joex worker services with persistent PostgreSQL, document storage and the supported search backend/configuration.
Configure shared authentication/secrets and URLs, initialize storage and verify both job processing and REST readiness; no supported single docspellapp/docspell container is assumed.

recipes.name: dokuwiki
requirements: Loopback-only evaluation. Complete application setup and authentication before exposing it through a TLS proxy.
Persistent named volumes start empty; configure the intended libraries, backups, or upstream services explicitly.

recipes.name: dolibarr
requirements: ERP demo with generated administrator/database credentials stored privately. Configure organization settings, email, TLS and backups before use.

recipes.name: drone
requirements: Configure a supported Drone server plus a separately authorized runner, database and persistent application data.
Provide Git-provider OAuth credentials, shared runner RPC secret and valid server URL/TLS; runners require a deliberately chosen isolated executor, not an implicit host Docker socket.

recipes.name: drupal
requirements: The Drupal installer is ready with a private PostgreSQL service named infinity-drupal-db. Enter the generated DB credentials from credentials.env in the installer.
Choose PostgreSQL in the installer, complete administrator onboarding and configure public hostname/TLS separately.

recipes.name: duplicati
requirements: UI password and settings encryption key are generated into the private credentials.env; configure authorized backup sources and an independent destination.
No host paths are mounted; the owned source and backup volumes start empty. VM deletion destroys both.

recipes.name: emby
requirements: Loopback-only evaluation. Complete application setup and authentication before exposing it through a TLS proxy.
Persistent named volumes start empty; configure the intended libraries, backups, or upstream services explicitly.

recipes.name: erpnext
requirements: Use the supported Frappe/ERPNext deployment bundle with version-matched backend/frontend, workers, scheduler, websocket services, MariaDB and Redis services.
Create and migrate an actual Frappe site with private administrator/database credentials, persistent sites/assets and a stable domain; verify all worker queues and frontend.

recipes.name: espocrm
requirements: Deploy persistent EspoCRM with a supported MariaDB/MySQL database, matching daemon/background processing, configured site URL and bootstrap administrator.
Run the documented initialization/migrations and configure email/TLS; verify scheduled jobs and authenticated application readiness.

recipes.name: etcd
requirements: Single-node durable evaluation store. Only loopback client HTTP is mapped; configure authenticated TLS and cluster recovery before broader use.

recipes.name: filebrowser
requirements: FileBrowser initializes a random administrator password on first boot; retrieve it privately from the owned container logs and rotate it.
Only owned named volumes are served; no host filesystem or Docker socket is exposed.

recipes.name: firefly-iii
requirements: Complete persistent private MariaDB plus Firefly III uploads, stable APP_KEY/APP_URL and initial user setup.
Configure the documented scheduled cron token/service, email, backups and TLS before recording financial data; verify migrations and authenticated readiness.

recipes.name: forgejo
requirements: Complete administrator onboarding through the SSH tunnel. Git-over-SSH is not mapped; this demo supports HTTP Git through the tunnel only.

recipes.name: ghost
requirements: Complete initial administrator setup through localhost SSH forwarding; isolated MySQL 8.4, Ghost content and credentials persist. Configure email, the public URL and HTTPS before publication.

recipes.name: gitlab
requirements: Choose a version-pinned supported GitLab Omnibus image and sufficient CPU/RAM/storage; persist /etc/gitlab, /var/log/gitlab and /var/opt/gitlab.
Set a stable external_url and ports, protect/rotate the initial administrator credential and configure email/TLS; verify all internal services before declaring readiness.

recipes.name: graylog
requirements: Deploy compatible Graylog, MongoDB and the version-supported Data Node/OpenSearch search backend with persistent journals and search/database data.
Generate password secret/admin hash, configure host kernel limits and collector inputs deliberately, and verify search/ingest and authenticated UI readiness.

recipes.name: guacamole
requirements: Provide matching Guacamole web and guacd services plus initialized persistent PostgreSQL/MySQL with the upstream schema loaded.
Configure private database credentials, replace bootstrap administrator credentials, allow only approved remote targets and verify the web and guacd paths; no host network is implicit.

recipes.name: homeassistant
requirements: Isolated bridge-network UI demo. Complete onboarding; host-network discovery, hardware devices and USB/Bluetooth capabilities are intentionally not granted.

recipes.name: immich
requirements: Use the version-matched supported Immich stack with PostgreSQL vector extensions, cache service, server and machine-learning service; persist uploads and database data.
Configure administrator onboarding, storage permissions and background jobs; GPU acceleration requires explicit compatible hardware and runtime.

recipes.name: influxdb
requirements: Bootstrap username, password and token are persisted in the owner-only credentials.env file; do not publish that file.

recipes.name: jenkins
requirements: Unlock Jenkins using the owner-only initialAdminPassword in /var/jenkins_home/secrets inside the owned container.
No host Docker socket or agent port is exposed; install trusted plugins and configure agents separately.

recipes.name: jitsi
requirements: Deploy matching Jitsi web, Prosody, Jicofo and JVB components with persistent configuration and shared authentication secrets.
Provide real public URL/TLS and explicitly reviewed UDP/media/NAT mappings or TURN configuration; a web-only HTTP container cannot certify meetings.

recipes.name: joomla
requirements: Isolated MariaDB-backed installer with persistent site files; complete administrator onboarding and TLS setup through the SSH tunnel.

recipes.name: jupyter
requirements: Token-authenticated scientific notebook; credentials stay in the mode-0600 file and notebooks persist in the owned work volume.
No GPUs, host mounts or remote kernels are configured. Execute only trusted notebooks.

recipes.name: kafka
requirements: Single-node KRaft plaintext evaluation, loopback-only; clients use localhost SSH forwarding matching the selected host port.
Configure TLS/SASL, replication and recovery before production; internal broker/controller listeners are not mapped.

recipes.name: kanboard
requirements: SQLite evaluation deployment starts with upstream administrator credentials; change them immediately through the SSH tunnel.

recipes.name: keycloak
requirements: Explicit development-mode HTTP evaluation with persistent PostgreSQL. Replace the temporary bootstrap administrator and use start with trusted hostname/TLS for production.

recipes.name: kibana
requirements: Provide a version-matched supported Elasticsearch cluster and persistent Kibana configuration with a service-account token, CA trust and stable encryption keys.
Perform authenticated cluster and UI readiness; never start a disconnected Kibana frontend or expose untrusted Elasticsearch credentials.

recipes.name: komga
requirements: Create the first administrator and add authorized media under /data through the SSH tunnel.

recipes.name: kopia
requirements: Encrypted filesystem repository and authenticated local HTTP UI; credentials live privately on the instance.
Add authorized snapshot sources and an independent backup destination. Deleting the VM destroys the local repository.

recipes.name: kuma
requirements: This planned entry duplicates uptime-kuma. Use the canonical uptime-kuma recipe for its owned persistent deployment and administrator onboarding.
A separate Kuma service-mesh integration would require a distinct name and a supported control-plane/data-plane deployment; no duplicate container is launched.

recipes.name: loki
requirements: Single-process durable filesystem-backed log store, loopback-only and unauthenticated; configure clients, retention, authorization, and backups separately.

recipes.name: mastodon
requirements: Deploy matching Mastodon web, streaming and Sidekiq services with PostgreSQL, Redis, persistent media and generated secrets.
Provide real federation domain/TLS, SMTP, administrator onboarding and job/search configuration; verify all components, not only the web process.

recipes.name: matrix-synapse
requirements: Complete a maintained Synapse homeserver with immutable server name/signing key, persistent PostgreSQL/media, explicit registration policy and administrator handling.
Choose either an explicitly localhost-only evaluation or a valid TLS/reverse-proxy/federation deployment; verify client, database and media readiness.

recipes.name: mattermost
requirements: Complete first-user/team onboarding. Private PostgreSQL and all stateful Mattermost paths persist; configure TLS/email and disable unintended public signups before publication.

recipes.name: meilisearch
requirements: API calls require the generated master key in the private credentials.env. Configure scoped API keys before sharing access.

recipes.name: metabase
requirements: Embedded H2 storage is for evaluation; migrate to a backed-up production application database before serious use.
Complete initial administrator onboarding through the SSH tunnel.

recipes.name: minio
requirements: Provide a presently supported licensed/maintained MinIO-compatible server image or reviewed source build; the legacy public minio/minio:latest availability is not assumed.
Initialize durable object storage, strong administrator credentials, S3 and console listeners, TLS and authenticated object persistence tests.

recipes.name: mongodb
requirements: Authenticated standalone MongoDB; configure replication and backups separately.
Connect using credentials from the instance-local owner-only credentials.env.

recipes.name: moodle
requirements: Build or supply a maintained supported Moodle application image matching its PHP/extensions, persistent Moodle data, database and scheduled cron.
Replace the unavailable Bitnami latest dependency, configure site URL/admin credentials/email/TLS, run installer/migrations and verify background tasks.

recipes.name: nats
requirements: JetStream persistence is enabled. Only monitoring is mapped to loopback; port 4222 is not exposed.
Configure authenticated NATS users and a deliberate client listener before attaching clients.

recipes.name: netdata
requirements: Unprivileged isolated-container diagnostics, not full host monitoring; no host /proc, /sys, device or Docker socket mounts are granted.
Cloud enrollment and host collectors require a deliberate separate configuration.

recipes.name: network-report
recipes.description: Read-only interface, route, resolver, and listening port diagnostics.

recipes.name: nextcloud
requirements: Complete Nextcloud plus MariaDB; generated administrator credentials are stored privately on the instance.
SSH tunnel hostname must be localhost/127.0.0.1. Configure cron, trusted public domain, Redis locking, TLS and backups before public use.

recipes.name: nocodb
requirements: Standalone SQLite evaluation; complete initial administrator onboarding. Configure external databases and backups before production.

recipes.name: oc-hunter
recipes.description: Bounded local OCI capacity helper that creates one exact managed instance without copying credentials into a guest.
requirements: A validated named OCI compute profile with an explicit compatible image, subnet, and SSH public key.
VM.Standard.A1.Flex or VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro eligibility and cost must be checked in your tenancy; no free-tier guarantee is implied.
Keep the private operation journal after interruptions; uncertain launches are not automatically repeated.

recipes.name: ollama
requirements: CPU-only daemon with no downloaded model. Pull an appropriately sized model explicitly; model execution is not a readiness check.
The unauthenticated API is loopback-only. GPU use requires compatible hardware/runtime not supplied by this recipe.

recipes.name: open-webui
requirements: Create the first administrator through the SSH tunnel. No model backend is bundled; configure a trusted authenticated inference endpoint in settings.

recipes.name: opencost
requirements: Provide a supported Kubernetes cluster and least-privilege kubeconfig, Prometheus metrics endpoint, matching OpenCost deployment and cluster identity.
Configure cloud pricing/integration inputs and UI/API forwarding deliberately; validate real metrics ingestion rather than a disconnected container.

recipes.name: opensearch
requirements: Complete version-pinned single-node or cluster configuration with persistent data, strong bootstrap password, reviewed host vm.max_map_count and resource limits.
Replace demo certificates/users for production and implement authenticated TLS/cluster readiness; never disable security to obtain a green liveness check.

recipes.name: outline
requirements: Deploy supported Outline with persistent PostgreSQL, Redis, object/file storage, secret keys and a valid URL.
Provide a supported OAuth/OIDC/SSO provider and required email credentials, TLS and migration/worker/readiness handling; anonymous startup is not a complete wiki.

recipes.name: owncloud
requirements: Persistent ownCloud plus private MariaDB with generated administrator credentials; connect through localhost SSH forwarding.
Configure Redis locking, background jobs, trusted public hostname, TLS and backups before public use.

recipes.name: paperless-ngx
requirements: Run version-compatible Paperless-ngx with persistent database, supported cache/broker and durable data/media/consume/export paths; bootstrap a real administrator.
Implement job/consumer readiness, permissions and secrets; add supported Tika/Gotenberg only when required and keep document processing isolated.

recipes.name: peertube
requirements: Deploy matching PeerTube, PostgreSQL and Redis with persistent media/configuration, generated secrets and initialized application data.
Provide federation hostname, SMTP, TLS and deliberately configured storage/transcoding resource limits; verify upload, worker and playback paths.

recipes.name: penpot
requirements: Deploy matching Penpot frontend/backend/exporter with persistent PostgreSQL and cache plus configured secrets, flags and application URI.
Map the actual frontend port 8080, configure authentication/TLS/email and verify backend/exporter readiness; a frontend-only container is incomplete.

recipes.name: pgadmin
requirements: Login with the generated owner-only bootstrap credentials, then register a separately managed PostgreSQL server. No database credentials are embedded.

recipes.name: phpmyadmin
requirements: Provide an explicitly selected managed MySQL/MariaDB target and an isolated phpMyAdmin deployment with private host/port/authentication settings.
Use authenticated database and HTTP readiness with stable blowfish/session secret; never allow arbitrary remote database destinations by default.

recipes.name: pihole
requirements: Persist /etc/pihole and version-compatible configuration with generated web administrator password and explicitly chosen private DNS clients/upstreams.
Review TCP/UDP 53 conflicts and capabilities before DNS service; do not implicitly enable public DNS, DHCP, host networking or network-admin privileges.

recipes.name: plex
requirements: Supply and authorize media explicitly. Account claiming and remote discovery are not configured; no privileged device access or public streaming port is granted.

recipes.name: prefect
requirements: Standalone evaluation server using durable SQLite. Configure authenticated access, workers, and production database separately.

recipes.name: rabbitmq
requirements: Only the management UI is mapped to loopback. Configure a separate deliberate AMQP mapping for clients.
Bootstrap credentials are persisted privately on the instance.

recipes.name: rancher
requirements: Provide a supported Kubernetes cluster and version-matched Rancher/Helm deployment, persistent state, bootstrap credentials and valid hostname/TLS.
Cluster administration capabilities and credential access require deliberate authorization; an implicitly privileged all-in-one Docker container is not supplied.

recipes.name: redmine
requirements: Change the upstream administrator password immediately through the SSH tunnel; the database and uploaded files have separate persistent volumes.

recipes.name: restic-rest-server
requirements: Provide a maintained rest-server version with durable repository storage, explicit htpasswd users and append-only policy where appropriate.
Configure authenticated TLS or loopback proxy, authorized clients and independent restore tests; a process-running check does not prove a backup.

recipes.name: rocket-chat
requirements: Deploy compatible Rocket.Chat with persistent MongoDB replica set/oplog configured and initialized for the chosen release.
Set a valid ROOT_URL, generated secrets/administrator, storage/email/integration settings and authenticated database/app readiness; verify selected image architecture.

recipes.name: rundeck
requirements: Deploy supported Rundeck with a durable application database and persistent project/plugin/data paths; configure URL, login credentials and encryption settings.
Provide only approved job-runner credentials/targets, configure TLS and verify scheduler plus authenticated API readiness.

recipes.name: seafile
requirements: Use the version-supported Seafile stack with persistent database, required cache and durable data/configuration; initialize administrator and site URL.
Provide TLS/proxy and background/file-service readiness, respecting release-specific object-storage/cache configuration and image architectures.

recipes.name: searxng
requirements: Configure permitted search engines, rate limits and proxy trust before external access. This local search frontend does not configure an authenticated publication layer.

recipes.name: sonarqube
requirements: Complete matching SonarQube plus persistent PostgreSQL with data/extensions/logs and verified vm.max_map_count, open-file/process limits and adequate memory.
Change the bootstrap administrator, verify search engine and application status, and configure TLS before accepting source code.

recipes.name: speedtest
requirements: Measures the tunnel-to-instance path; it is not a general bandwidth certification. Publishing the test requires deliberate ingress and resource limits.

recipes.name: stirling-pdf
requirements: Loopback-only evaluation. Complete application setup and authentication before exposing it through a TLS proxy.
Persistent named volumes start empty; configure the intended libraries, backups, or upstream services explicitly.

recipes.name: strapi
requirements: Build or supply a reviewed supported Strapi application image containing the actual project, dependencies and matching Node version; the old strapi/strapi image is legacy v3.
Configure persistent database/uploads, application JWT/encryption secrets, administrator bootstrap, migrations and health endpoint for that project.

recipes.name: superset
requirements: Deploy a supported Superset image with persistent metadata PostgreSQL, SECRET_KEY, initialized schema/administrator and the selected worker/cache/scheduler services.
Configure drivers/datasource credentials and async job policy explicitly; verify authenticated web and worker readiness before analysis.

recipes.name: syncthing
requirements: Only the GUI is mapped to loopback. Configure a GUI password and authenticated peer devices before use.
Synchronizing with remote peers requires deliberately configured ports 22000/TCP/UDP and 21027/UDP; this demo does not open them.

recipes.name: system-report
recipes.description: Read-only operating-system, CPU, memory, filesystem, and socket diagnostics.

recipes.name: taiga
requirements: Deploy matching Taiga frontend/backend/async/event services with PostgreSQL, broker, media storage, shared secrets and configuration.
Provide stable frontend/backend URLs, email/admin initialization and proxy/TLS; a frontend-only Docker mapping does not implement project management.

recipes.name: temporal
requirements: Provide the version-supported persistent PostgreSQL/MySQL schema setup, Temporal server and UI with consistent namespace/authentication configuration.
Persist server data and configure client/worker endpoints explicitly; verify a workflow round-trip instead of only UI process liveness.

recipes.name: traccar
requirements: Complete first-account onboarding. Device listener ports are intentionally not mapped; configure authenticated device ingress separately.

recipes.name: traefik
requirements: Explicit local dashboard evaluation with a file provider and no host Docker socket. Configure routes/TLS/authentication in the persistent /data volume before serving applications.

recipes.name: umami
requirements: Persisted PostgreSQL analytics application; change the upstream starter administrator password immediately through the SSH tunnel.
Configure authorized tracked sites, privacy settings and TLS before collecting real visitor data.

recipes.name: vault
requirements: Implement a supported non-development Vault server with durable integrated Raft storage, TLS/listener configuration and adequate locked-memory capability.
Initialization/unseal keys and root-token custody are a separate explicit operator procedure; never auto-print credentials or substitute an insecure dev server.

recipes.name: vaultwarden
requirements: Create the first vault account over an SSH tunnel, then disable signups in persistent configuration.
The admin endpoint is disabled; configure TLS and a separate admin token before external publication.

recipes.name: vikunja
requirements: Register the first user through the SSH tunnel; configure public URL, authentication policy and email before public use.

recipes.name: vllm
requirements: Provide a supported GPU VM, compatible drivers/NVIDIA container runtime, sufficient VRAM/RAM/storage and a version/platform-matched vLLM image.
Choose an authorized model/token, supply API authentication and loopback listener settings, then verify an actual inference response; default 2-GB CPU VMs cannot run this workload.

recipes.name: wallabag
requirements: Database and captured images persist privately; change upstream starter login credentials immediately through the SSH tunnel. Configure public URL/TLS/email before publication.

recipes.name: weaviate
requirements: Complete a version-pinned persistent single-node or cluster deployment with explicit authentication/authorization and supported vectorizer configuration.
Provide required model/API credentials only for chosen modules and validate object/vector operations and storage persistence; no external model backend is assumed.

recipes.name: woodpecker
requirements: Deploy matching Woodpecker server and a separately authorized agent with durable database/configuration, shared agent secret and valid server URL.
Provide forge OAuth credentials and deliberately choose an isolated execution backend; do not mount the host Docker socket by default.

recipes.name: wordpress
requirements: Persistent isolated MariaDB and WordPress; complete the site installer over the SSH tunnel and configure HTTPS before publication.

recipes.name: xwiki
requirements: Deploy supported XWiki with initialized persistent PostgreSQL/MySQL and durable /usr/local/xwiki data/configuration, matching JDBC settings and application version.
Complete the distribution wizard and administrator registration, configure email/TLS and validate authenticated database/application readiness.

recipes.name: zabbix
requirements: Run version-matched Zabbix server, frontend and initialized persistent MySQL/PostgreSQL schema with private database credentials and durable server data.
Configure monitored agent/proxy access deliberately and rotate bootstrap administrator credentials; verify both monitoring server and authenticated frontend readiness.
